data: Does the LCSeg algorithm perform better than the BayesSeg algorithm when the number of segments is 14?

To determine whether the LCSeg algorithm performs better than the BayesSeg algorithm when the number of segments is 14, I will analyze the graph at the point where the x-axis value is 14. At this point, the y-axis values for both algorithms are visible. The LCSeg line is above the BayesSeg line, indicating that LCSeg has a higher average F-measure than BayesSeg at this point. Therefore, the LCSeg algorithm performs better than the BayesSeg algorithm when the number of segments is 14.
